info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Information API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Information API allows businesses to access detailed billing data associated with their corporate accounts. Users can retrieve comprehensive billing statements, payment history, and transaction details, facilitating better financial management and auditing processes. This endpoint is particularly useful for finance teams and corporate administrators seeking transparency and insights into billing activities. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their budgeting and forecasting efforts, ensuring that they remain informed about their expenditures.

get.summary: Retrieve corporate billing details for a specific payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding the corporate billing for payment ID PAY-300045. It includes all relevant data related to the billing process, such as amounts, dates, and related entities, ensuring that users have comprehensive visibility into their billing status.
